text: Natural language processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand and work with human language. Instead of just recognizing words, NLP focuses on the meaning behind them. This technology powers many everyday tools, such as automatic translation services that convert text between languages. It also drives sentiment analysis, which companies use to judge whether customer reviews are positive, negative, or neutral. Additionally, NLP is the engine behind modern chatbots, allowing them to answer questions and hold simple conversations. By combining grammar rules with machine learning, NLP is making human-computer interaction more natural and useful every day.
